description: This file defines the FileCache class in Drupal, implementing file-based caching with methods for retrieving, setting, deleting, and resetting cache entries, utilizing file modification times and an optional backend cache.

classes.name: FileCache
classes.description: A class for caching data based on file modification dates, supporting multiple cache backends and static cache.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a FileCache object with specified prefix, collection, and optional backend class and configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a single file path.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for multiple file paths, utilizing static cache and backend cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data in cache for a specific file path.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entry for a specific file path.
